request.description: Refine this same upright champion. Preserve face, hood, pose, sword, hands, feet and proportions. Add BODY AUGMENTS: corroded bronze half-ribs grafted into exposed left chest, mechanical tendon brace from right shoulder to elbow, and articulated bronze left shin replacing flesh with dark joints. Tiny ember fissures at skin-metal seams. Asymmetric, visibly implanted, rotted Medjay sepia/ash palette, restrained light. Clear pixel clusters, no neon or bulky armour. Transparent.
